about.title: About Bandmate
about.subtitle: The complete band management platform
about.whatIsBandmateDesc: Bandmate is a comprehensive web application designed to help bands manage their songs, setlists, shows, and members in one centralized platform. Built with modern web technologies, it helps musicians stay organized and collaborate efficiently.
about.oauthAuthDesc: Secure sign-in with GitHub or Google accounts
about.bandManagementFeatureDesc: Create and manage multiple bands with different members
about.memberRolesDesc: Invite members and guests with role-based permissions
about.songLibraryFeatureDesc: Store songs with titles, artists, lyrics, and chords
about.setlistManagementDesc: Create, edit, and perform setlists with full-screen view
about.guestAccessDesc: Time-limited access for temporary members and substitutes
about.themesDesc: Toggle between themes for comfortable viewing
about.showSchedulingDesc: Track gigs, venues, and performance history
about.emailNotificationsDesc: Automatic email alerts for invitations and updates
about.fileAttachmentsDesc: Upload PDFs, images, and audio files to songs
about.advancedSearchDesc: Filter and search songs by key, tempo, and more
about.footerText: Bandmate is in active development. We're constantly adding new features and improvements to help musicians collaborate better.
